answers.core: This appears a small change with potentially major impact on readability, usability and I believe it could get a lot of use. The docs will correctly explain that `int`, `float`, `bool` and `string` are simply there for convenience as a shorthand way of writing the full typing syntax `var : type` and only these 4 types get a shorthand. GDScript only.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around simply by using current typing GDScript typing syntax.

title: int, float, bool, string keywords as shorthand to var : type syntax used by GDScript
